w10_P4_001219: A materials bench has 9 clamp posts, and any two of them may be bridged by a test link. The controller counts the number of distinct pairs of posts that could be bridged and adds 14 to that count, and the result is the carriage's speed in metres per second. The carriage has a mass of 32 kg, and the bench room is at 21 degrees C. From the energy the carriage carries by virtue of its motion, 1 J is deducted for the release catch, and the corrected figure is expressed in kilojoules. The bench performs 9 identical runs. What total energy, in kJ, do the runs record?
w10_P4_001220: A test house needs the total energy, in joules, from one afternoon of catapult firings. The launcher's raw index is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 6*x between x = 1 and x = 4, where x is the arm setting, and 25 is then subtracted from that index to give the projectile's launch speed in metres per second. The projectile has a mass of 47000 g. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is the figure recorded for one firing. The house fires 7 shots in a series and completes 5 identical series during the afternoon. What is the afternoon's total, in J?
w10_P4_001236: A hammer mill brings its rotor blocks up to speed in 3 identical stages, and each stage contributes 8 m/s while the clutch engages and a further 9 m/s while it drives. A rotor block has a mass of 20000 g and swings at the accumulated speed. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is the figure recorded for one block. A rotor carries 10 identical blocks, and the mill runs 10 identical rotors. The plant's combined figure is expressed in kilojoules. What total energy, in kJ, does the plant hold?
w10_P4_001237: A workshop needs the final figure, in kilojoules, at the foot of its trolley sheet. The trolley's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 3v + 2 = 0. The trolley has a mass of 31 kg, and the workshop sits at 18 degrees C. From the energy the trolley carries by virtue of its motion, 24 J is deducted for the bearing losses, and the corrected figure is multiplied by the 5 trolleys on the rail. The result is expressed in kilojoules, and a charged buffer then adds 2 kJ. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001250: A bearing laboratory needs the total figure, in kilojoules, for a spindle test. Two index rings carry 22 notches and 15 notches, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The gearbox then runs the test slider at 2 times that number, in metres per second, and the slider has a mass of 29 kg. The energy the slider carries by virtue of that motion is multiplied by the 3 sliders on a spindle, and the spindle's figure is expressed in kilojoules. The laboratory runs 6 identical spindles. What is the total figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001264: A ski-jump research team is preparing a test sled. The sled's base index b is the smaller value satisfying b^2 - 14*b + 48 = 0, and the gearing multiplies that index by 7. A wind correction then adds 11 to the geared figure and a drag correction takes 4 away from it, and what remains is the sled's launch speed in metres per second. The sled has a mass of 26 kg, and the snow is at 3 degrees C. The team records the energy the sled carries by virtue of that motion. What is that energy, in kJ?
w10_P4_001265: An offshore contractor is rating a pile-driving frame. The hammer's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is built from a train of pulses in which pulse number k contributes 2*k - 1, with k running from 1 up to 8. The hammer has a mass of 181000 g, and the frame supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A deck carries 9 identical hammers, and a standing rigging pre-load of 23 N is added to the deck's combined force. The vessel works 9 identical decks. What total force, in kN, does the vessel apply?
w10_P4_001266: A rolling mill is rating a new screwdown drive. The screw carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the area under the curve 4*x^2 + 4*x between x = 3 and x = 4, where x is the pressure-setting index. The carriage has a mass of 89000 g, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A stand carries 11 identical drives, and a guide pad relieves 2 N of the stand's combined force. The mill runs 12 identical stands. What total force, in N, does the mill apply?
w10_P4_001275: A cement plant needs the total figure, in kilonewtons, for its whole conveyor section. Each take-up carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 9a + 8 = 0. A carriage has a mass of 142000 g, and each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, recorded in kilonewtons. A frame carries 10 identical drives, a line carries 10 frames, and the plant has 12 identical lines. What total figure, in kN, does the conveyor section show?
w10_P4_001276: A shipyard needs the final figure, in kilonewtons, for a capstan installation. Two index wheels carry 159 teeth and 89 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The capstan carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is set numerically equal to that number, and the carriage has a mass of 148000 g. Each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and a deck carries 10 identical drives. A standing rope pre-load of 21 N is added to the deck's combined force, and the yard fits 5 identical decks. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001277: A cable-drum works needs the final total, in kilojoules, for a test rack. The test carrier is brought up to speed by 4 identical drive stages, and each stage contributes 8 m/s while the clutch engages and a further 5 m/s while it drives. The carrier has a mass of 30000 g and runs at the accumulated speed. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules, a charged latch then adds 9 kJ, and an accumulator adds a further 17 kJ. The works runs 7 identical racks. What is the final total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001280: A drop-hammer laboratory needs the final entry, in kilojoules, for one test. The hammer's release speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 7*x between x = 0 and x = 3, where x is the trip-lever index. The hammer has a mass of 34000 g. To the energy it carries by virtue of that motion the sheet adds 6 J for the latch, then subtracts 30 J for the guide friction and a further 28 J for the anvil pad. The result is finally expressed in kilojoules. What is the final entry, in kJ?
w10_P4_001282: A press shop needs the total force, in newtons, applied across the whole works. The ram's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the area under the curve 2*x^2 + 6*x between x = 2 and x = 4, where x is the valve index, and the shop floor sits at 24 degrees C. The ram has a mass of 168 kg, and each press supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A bay holds 5 identical presses, a hall holds 11 bays, and a standing frame pre-load of 16 N is added to a hall's combined force. The works has 3 identical halls. What total force, in N, does the works apply?
w10_P4_001283: A paper mill is setting up a new slitter drive. Two change gears carry 325 teeth and 82 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. A control offset then adds 20 to that number, and the result is the carriage's rate of change of speed in m/s^2. The carriage has a mass of 101 kg, and the drive house is at 26 degrees C. Each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and the mill runs 12 identical drives. A standing web tension of 21 N is added to their combined force, and a guide pad then relieves 1 N. What total force, in N, does the mill apply?
w10_P4_001287: A test track brings a sled up to speed with 5 identical booster packs, and each pack contributes 4 m/s while it burns and a further 7 m/s while it vents. A tail thruster then adds another 13 m/s, and the sled runs at the accumulated speed. The sled has a mass of 48000 g. From the energy the sled carries by virtue of that motion, 10 J is deducted for the rail friction. The track completes 6 identical runs and expresses their combined figure in kilojoules. What is that total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001292: A dockyard is rating a warping capstan. The capstan carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is built from a train of pulses in which pulse number k contributes 2*k - 1, with k running from 1 up to 8. The carriage has a mass of 50 kg, and the capstan supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A rope guide adds 20 N to the capstan's load, a fairlead adds a further 8 N, and a chain stopper adds another 23 N. The dockyard runs 11 identical capstans. What total load, in N, do the capstans carry?
w10_P4_001296: A theme park needs the total figure, in kilojoules, held by its whole ride fleet. Each car is brought up to speed by 2 identical launch coils, and every coil contributes 5 m/s while it charges and a further 16 m/s while it discharges. A car has a mass of 27 kg and runs at the accumulated speed, and the energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A train holds 8 identical cars, a ride runs 8 trains, and the park operates 3 identical rides. What total figure, in kJ, does the fleet hold?
w10_P4_001299: A steelworks needs the total force, in newtons, applied by its whole pusher section. The pusher's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 2*x between x = 0 and x = 3, where x is the valve index. The pusher ram has a mass of 123 kg, and each unit supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A guide shoe relieves 7 N of that force and a seal relieves a further 25 N. A furnace carries 10 identical pushers, and the works has 3 identical furnaces. What total force, in N, does the pusher section apply?
w10_P4_001301: A shot-blasting plant throws steel media from a spinning wheel. Each of the 5 acceleration vanes contributes 7 m/s while it grips the media and a further 4 m/s while it releases, so the media leaves at the accumulated speed. A media charge has a mass of 59 kg, and the cabinet is held at 30 degrees C. The energy the charge carries by virtue of its motion is multiplied by the 3 wheels on a machine, then by the 10 machines in a bay, then by the 9 bays in the plant. A control heater finally adds 20 J to the plant's figure. What is the plant's total, in J?
w10_P4_001302: A gear shop needs the net figure, in kilojoules, at the foot of its test sheet. Two index plates carry 76 holes and 291 holes, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The test slider then runs at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number, and the slider has a mass of 46 kg. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules, and a standing rig overhead of 21 kJ is subtracted from it. The shop runs 4 sliders on a bench and operates 7 identical benches. What is the net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001305: A climbing-wall laboratory tests a fall arrester on a rig with 13 anchor eyes. The controller sets the test mass's fall speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to the number of distinct pairs of eyes that a rope could link. The test mass has a mass of 24000 g, and the laboratory is kept at 20 degrees C. The energy the mass carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A standing rig allowance of 25 kJ, an instrument allowance of 21 kJ and a frame allowance of 28 kJ are then subtracted from it in turn. What is the laboratory's net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001321: A printing works is setting up a folder drive. Two change wheels carry 62 teeth and 211 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. A calibration then subtracts 24 from that number and adds a further 28 to what remains, and the result is the carriage's rate of change of speed in m/s^2. The carriage has a mass of 52000 g, and each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. The works runs 5 identical drives, and a guide pad then relieves 13 N of their combined force. What total force, in N, does the works apply?
w10_P4_001323: A cable works needs the total thrust, in newtons, from a capstan frame. The base value b is the larger solution of b^2 - 6*b + 8 = 0, a control offset then adds 15 to it, and the gearbox multiplies the result by 2, giving the carriage's rate of change of speed in m/s^2. The carriage has a mass of 54 kg, and the machine hall is at 23 degrees C. Each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. The frame carries 3 identical drives. What total thrust, in N, does the frame deliver?
w10_P4_001325: A mine is rating a new conveyor booster. The base rate b, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying b^2 - 12*b + 32 = 0, and a control offset adds a further 22, giving the carriage's actual rate of change of speed. The carriage has a mass of 143000 g, and the booster supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A guide roller relieves 1 N of that force, and a tension spring then adds 19 N. The rating sheet expresses the result in kilonewtons. What figure, in kN, does the rating sheet show?
w10_P4_001326: A flywheel laboratory needs the final total, in kilojoules, for a test bank. Two index rings carry 206 teeth and 208 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. Each test slider is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number, and a slider has a mass of 10000 g. The energy one slider carries by virtue of its motion is multiplied by the 9 sliders on a rig, and the rig's figure is expressed in kilojoules. The bank contains 11 identical rigs, and a charged buffer then adds 19 kJ. What is the final total, in kJ?
